.²1 Becoming quiet, assuagement, pacification; {#kuto'syA upaSamaH#} <ls>Ve. 3</ls>;
 {#manyurduHsaha eza yAtyupaSamaM no sAntvavAdEH sPuwam#} <ls>Amaru. 6</ls>;
 cessation, stopping, extinction.
.²2 Relaxation, intermission.
.²3 Tranquility, calmness, patience; {#upaSamaSIlAH paramarzayaH#} <ls>Bhāg. 5. 4. 27</ls>.
 {#upaSamAyanezu svatanayezu#} <ls>Bhāg. 5. 1. 29</ls>. {#jYAnasyopaSamaH#} <ls>Bh. 2. 82</ls>.
.²4 Control or restraint of the senses.
.²5 (in <ab>Astron.</ab>) <ab>N.</ab> of the twentieth Muhūrta.
(with Jainas) the destruction of activity <ab>&c.</ab> through quietism.
